arguments.literal: Authority is never minted from capability, a label or reachability.

goal_reprice re-enters at the current work wave; intent_reprice at direction or scope; product_reprice at current product shape while intent holds; requirement_reprice at constitutional truth while direction holds; design_reframe at realisation structure while requirements hold; realization_refactor at local realisation with no intended upstream change.

Changed material inputs or a declared revising observation invalidate the affected result before reliance, preserving the predecessor and any demonstrably independent surviving results; a changed basis invalidates likewise.
Return A Closed Result names inputs and observation; TICKET judgment continuity names basis.
A changed governing relation is accepted only at its owner; accepting it inside the acting frame is a violation, whatever the size of the delta.
A closed result is reused by an unchanged consumer after an applicability check; a role, conversation or resumption change alone invalidates nothing.
Compute the material closure of the seed set under the relation family on the exact basis; if the closure is not finite and unique, the step returns a gap or refusal and does not guess.

A composite over several results declares its conjunction; the member it reports is chosen by that declared rule; every known failure and uncovered obligation survives the join and is carried with the composite; no universal order among the non-satisfied members exists.
For steps s1: X -> Y and s2: Y -> Z, the composite s2 after s1 exists only under P4a; its output carries both steps' step-produced facts.
A composition law is required only where the governing evaluation combines internal variables or transports values across steps; independent closed results may instead go to one declared conjunction.
Later counterevidence arrives.
Every dependent verdict is invalidated until the claim-evidence relation is requalified.
Required coupled relations must fit together in some step; unrelated obligations stay outside the selected context.

Dispositions after any non-satisfied result are named in advance: continue within the current contract when supported; refine; recover; yield; re-enter the owning relation; terminate. Each admitted condition class has a declared disposition, including an explicit unknown class.

An evidence surface, proof, matrix, coverage record or test suite cannot by itself select, enlarge or replace the outcome; where an assurance capability is itself defined as product behaviour, its delivery is progress and its evidence still does not author the claim.
A composite with a known failure or an uncovered required obligation cannot project success; a known failure A and an uncovered obligation B survive every join.

An outer transformation T: A -> X with success predicates P0 ... Pn is faithfully refined by steps T_i when each admitted input satisfying P_i yields an output satisfying P_i+1, retains every applicable invariant, exposes other outcomes without coercion, and each output satisfies the next step's domain and preconditions; then a successful composite carries P0 to Pn by induction.
A judgment is recorded over an unchanged subject with evaluator, decision, evidence, scope and revising observation.

Where evidence is missing because a relation or capability needed to obtain it was not declared, the result is out_of_frame; indeterminate is reserved for the case where the declared capability was exercised and the admissible evidence still cannot decide.
A step, claim or result binds one exact immutable basis; mixed bases need an explicit composite relation.
A missing, failed or out-of-scope result returns its own member, never satisfied.
Adequacy of a transformation is judged against a selected, owner-defined, directly verifiable outcome with an acceptance interval.
A finite actor realises a selected outer contract through steps; each step's selected context fits the actor's envelope; the actor's internal path within a step is its own.
Standing: recovered as a composite; the generic statement is reframed from the graph profile's graph functions.
A selected outcome defines adequacy; interfaces inherit material obligations from the transformation they serve.
Standing: independent. Identical capacity serves opposite purposes.

Two steps compose only when the first's result type and judgment satisfy the second's domain and preconditions; composition retains both identities, intermediate results, judgments, evidence, authority, provenance and stop states.
Standing: independent.
Judgments, residuals, observations and authority decisions the outer contract needs are recorded by the step that produced them.

Standing: derived; reframed from AC-009, AC-013, AC-005, UP-017 and UP-021, whose nine statements of conservation become one obligation with typed instances (authority, residual, judgment, frame, transition, successor claim, evidence by reference); each source clause continues to govern its own scope.

A step can meet a condition outside its context and cannot report success on one; its result algebra carries indeterminate, out_of_frame and invalid_basis as first-class outcomes and its control model names the next move.
Standing: derived.
Definitions, assumptions, observations, candidate judgments and accepted claims have distinct standing; evidence supports a claim on a basis; authority permits or disposes within scope.
Standing: independent. A bounded actor satisfying all else can still take a green label as acceptance.
The actor of one step need not be the actor of the next; a later actor may re-acquire declared sources but not a prior actor's private memory.
A step's output is a candidate until evaluated.
The world is open: a step may meet conditions outside its selected context.
P0 presupposes a selected outcome (P2).

Progress is accepted material movement toward the selected outcome; prerequisite work names what it enables; preservation and repeated proof are evidence, not progress; rejected or superseded construction is churn; discovering hidden distance revises the forecast and is not negative progress; volume of documents, code, tests, commits or reviews is not progress.

Project the closure to the selected context, recording its boundary: the excluded, external, unresolved, translated and invalidation-sensitive seams; material not in the closure stays out; adjacent material does not enter because it exists.

Coverage of the outer obligations, correctness of the local implications and legitimate authority are premises of the induction, not conclusions; 'each step passed' is weaker than 'the outer contract was conserved'.
A material uncertainty, omission, loss or unproven relation remains a residual until an authorised disposition.
One core algebra of exactly these five members serves every evaluation and every step's stop state.
Reusing the constructor's judgment does not satisfy independence; shared mechanical evidence may be reused, judgment may not.
A reused judgment does not satisfy a separately required independent judgment; the independent assessor acquires its own evidence and supplies its own judgment.
Every seam crossing the affected set includes its far side or states why it cannot participate.
A constructor's self-review is construction output, not assessment.
A step's output is a candidate plus its step-produced facts (judgments with evidence, residuals, observations, authority decisions, provenance) and one stop state from the result algebra.

A step-produced fact is a judgment, residual, observation or authority decision produced by a step that cannot be re-acquired from declared sources; an observation reproducible from declared sources is re-acquirable, is not a step-produced fact, and is governed by sufficiency, not conservation.

Every substantive change, whatever its intake label, enters through one intake triage that names the smallest lawful re-entry point; triage records the change intent, the class, the re-entry point and when triage occurred, wherever substantive work begins.
Every transformation records what it preserved, introduced and removed, its external resolution witnesses and its residuals.
Admission of a material transition is one semantic commit of the complete transition within its enclosing relation, or none.
For required obligations R and admitted coverage C, uncovered coverage is R minus C; combining results takes the union of known failures and recomputes uncovered coverage.

Every outcome-bearing work wave names one selected, unresolved, directly verifiable outcome and its acceptance interval. Progress is judged only against it: material advance is progress; prerequisite work names the obligation it enables; preservation is evidence; regression blocks the affected path.

frame_indexes.scope: Join bounded results under an outer contract: typed composition, conservation accounting, coverage, the declared conjunction, faithful refinement and the triage of a detected failure. Selected for the T-03 and T-04 cases.
